280      async def publish(
  281          self,
  282          session: AsyncSession,
  283          context: WorkspaceExecutionContext,
  284          agent_id: UUID,
  285      ) -> PublishedAgentVersion:
  286          self._require_permission(context, "agent_edit")
  287          workspace_id = _workspace_id(context)
  288          agent = await self._load_agent(session, context, agent_id, for_update=True)
  289          if agent is None:
  290              raise AgentHubError("AGENT_NOT_FOUND", "The agent was not found.", 404)
  291          resolved_spec, resolved_spec_hash = await self._resolve_draft_spec(session, context, agent)
  292          version_number = (
  293              await session.scalar(
  294                  select(func.max(AgentVersion.version_number)).where(
  295                      AgentVersion.agent_id == agent.id,
  296                      AgentVersion.workspace_id == workspace_id,
  297                  )
  298              )
  299              or 0
  300          ) + 1
  301          version = AgentVersion(
  302              workspace_id=workspace_id,
  303              agent_id=agent.id,
  304              version_number=version_number,
  305              spec_schema_version=resolved_spec["spec_schema_version"],
  306              resolved_spec=resolved_spec,
  307              resolved_spec_hash=resolved_spec_hash,
  308              created_by=_principal_id(context),
  309          )
  310          session.add(version)
  311          try:
  312              await session.commit()
  313          except IntegrityError as exc:
  314              await session.rollback()
  315              raise AgentHubError(
  316                  "AGENT_VERSION_CONFLICT", "The agent version could not be published.", 409
  317              ) from exc
  318          return PublishedAgentVersion(
  319              id=version.id,
  320              agent_id=version.agent_id,
  321              workspace_id=version.workspace_id,
  322              version_number=version.version_number,
  323              resolved_spec_hash=version.resolved_spec_hash,
  324              created_at=version.created_at,
  325          )

29  def get_production_agent_run_service(request: Request) -> AgentRunService:
   30      app: FastAPI = request.app
   31      factory = getattr(app.state, "db_session_factory", None)
   32      if factory is None:
   33          raise AgentHubError("DATABASE_NOT_CONFIGURED", "Database access is not configured.", 503)
   34      service = getattr(app.state, "agent_run_service", None)
   35      if service is None:
   36          from apps.worker.celery_app import create_celery_app
   37  
   38          settings = app.state.settings
   39          trace_sink = ProductionTraceSink()
   40          components = production_retrieval_components(settings)
   41          retriever = SessionScopedKnowledgeRetriever(
   42              session_factory=factory,
   43              components=components,
   44              rrf_k=settings.knowledge_rrf_k,
   45              min_rerank_score=settings.knowledge_min_rerank_score,
   46              superseded_rank_penalty=settings.knowledge_superseded_rank_penalty,
   47              trace_sink=trace_sink,
   48          )
   49          # One executor serves both sides of the approval boundary: the same
   50          # connection lookup and the same single call, read one way for a READ
   51          # and another for a WRITE.
   52          mcp_executor = McpToolExecutor(factory, settings=settings)
   53          service = AgentRunService(
   54              factory,
   55              credential_cipher=ProviderCredentialCipher.from_settings(settings),
   56              tool_runtime=ToolRuntime(
   57                  session_factory=factory,
   58                  registry=ToolRegistry(
   59                      retriever=retriever,
   60                      section_selector=onyx_section_selector_from_settings(settings),
   61                  ),
   62                  audit_sink=SqlAlchemyToolAuditSink(factory),
   63                  trace_sink=trace_sink,
   64                  mcp_handler=mcp_executor.execute_read,
   65              ),
   66              trace_sink=trace_sink,
   67              approval_service=ApprovalService(factory, ttl_seconds=settings.approval_ttl_seconds),
   68              action_runtime=ActionRuntime(
   69                  session_factory=factory, mcp_executor=McpActionExecutor(mcp_executor)
   70              ),
   71              checkpoint_adapter=LangGraphCheckpointAdapter(settings.database_url),
   72              # The work layer's two adapters. Without them the runtime behaves
   73              # exactly as it did before threads existed, which is what keeps a
   74              # Playground run unchanged.
   75              thread_context_provider=SqlAlchemyThreadContextProvider(factory),
   76              # Long-term memory, both halves. Selection reads the store
   77              # directly; extraction is queued so that learning never runs on the
   78              # path a user is waiting on. Both are no-ops for every agent whose
   79              # published spec has not turned the switch on. See ADR-011.
   80              memory_selector=SqlAlchemyMemoryStore(factory),
   81              memory_writer=CeleryMemoryWriteQueue(create_celery_app(settings)),
   82              artifact_recorder=ToolResultArtifactRecorder(factory),
   83              # Held on app.state, so the registry of live runs outlives the
   84              # request that started any one of them -- which is the whole point.
   85              stream_grace_seconds=settings.run_stream_grace_seconds,
   86          )
   87          app.state.agent_run_service = service
   88      return service

18  def evidence_record(item: RetrievedEvidence, *, snapshot_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
   19      # Identity fields (chunk_id, document_revision_id) stay because projection
   20      # and registry pairing key on them; the model-irrelevant provenance string
   21      # and the two ranking scores were measured to cost ~180 bytes per record
   22      # of pure metadata overhead against a 5000-byte evidence pool.
   23      record = {
   24          "chunk_id": item.chunk_id,
   25          "document_id": item.document_id,
   26          "document_revision_id": item.document_revision_id,
   27          "locator": dict(item.locator),
   28          "snippet": item.text[:MAX_EVIDENCE_EXCERPT_CHARS],
   29          "document_name": item.metadata.get("document_name"),
   30          "effective_date": item.metadata.get("effective_date"),
   31          "superseded": bool(item.metadata.get("superseded", False)),
   32      }
   33      if snapshot_id is not None:
   34          record["snapshot_id"] = snapshot_id
   35      return record

131      async def load(
  132          self,
  133          *,
  134          workspace_id: UUID,
  135          memory_ids: tuple[UUID, ...],
  136          memory_content_hashes: dict[UUID | str, str] | None = None,
  137      ) -> tuple[SelectedMemory, ...]:
  138          """Re-read a frozen selection, in the order it was frozen.
  139  
  140          A run replaying its own snapshot must see what it saw, including rows
  141          that have since been superseded or invalidated: the snapshot records
  142          what the model was told, and rewriting history to be tidier would make
  143          the run log a worse answer to "why did it say that" than it is now.
  144          """
  145  
  146          if not memory_ids:
  147              if memory_content_hashes:
  148                  raise MemorySnapshotIntegrityError(
  149                      "The frozen memory snapshot contains unexpected content hashes."
  150                  )
  151              return ()
  152          async with self.session_factory() as session:
  153              rows = (
  154                  await session.scalars(
  155                      select(WorkspaceMemory).where(
  156                          WorkspaceMemory.workspace_id == workspace_id,
  157                          WorkspaceMemory.id.in_(memory_ids),
  158                      )
  159                  )
  160              ).all()
  161          by_id = {row.id: row for row in rows}
  162          if memory_content_hashes is None:
  163              # ID-only snapshots predate hash freezing and remain replayable.
  164              return tuple(_selected(by_id[key]) for key in memory_ids if key in by_id)
  165          if len(set(memory_ids)) != len(memory_ids) or len(by_id) != len(set(memory_ids)):
  166              raise MemorySnapshotIntegrityError(
  167                  "The frozen memory snapshot references a missing or duplicate memory."
  168              )
  169          expected_keys = {str(key) for key in memory_content_hashes}
  170          if expected_keys != {str(key) for key in memory_ids}:
  171              raise MemorySnapshotIntegrityError(
  172                  "The frozen memory snapshot hash set does not match its memory ids."
  173              )
  174          selected: list[SelectedMemory] = []
  175          for key in memory_ids:
  176              row = by_id.get(key)
  177              expected = memory_content_hashes.get(key) or memory_content_hashes.get(str(key))
  178              if row is None or not isinstance(expected, str) or row.content_hash != expected:
  179                  raise MemorySnapshotIntegrityError(
  180                      "The frozen memory snapshot does not match the stored memory."
  181                  )
  182              selected.append(_selected(row))
  183          return tuple(selected)

472      async def _resolve_model(
  473          self, session: AsyncSession, context: WorkspaceExecutionContext, agent: Agent
  474      ) -> tuple[tuple[ResolvedModelProfile, ...], dict[UUID, str]]:
  475          repository = SqlAlchemyModelGatewayRepository(session)
  476          resolver = ModelProfileResolver(repository)
  477          bindings = await session.scalars(
  478              select(AgentTool).where(
  479                  AgentTool.workspace_id == agent.workspace_id,
  480                  AgentTool.agent_id == agent.id,
  481              )
  482          )
  483          required = CapabilityRequirements(
  484              required=frozenset({"tool_calling"} if list(bindings) else set())
  485          )
  486          try:
  487              chain = await resolver.resolve_chain(
  488                  context,
  489                  agent.model_profile_id,
  490                  required_capabilities=required,
  491              )
  492          except ModelGatewayError as exc:
  493              if exc.code == ModelGatewayErrorCode.MODEL_CAPABILITY_MISMATCH:
  494                  raise AgentHubError(
  495                      "MODEL_CAPABILITY_MISMATCH",
  496                      "The selected model chain lacks a required capability.",
  497                      422,
  498                  ) from None
  499              raise _model_profile_unavailable() from None
  500          providers: dict[UUID, str] = {}
  501          for profile in chain:
  502              credential = await repository.get_provider_credential(
  503                  context, profile.provider_credential_id
  504              )
  505              if credential is None or not credential.enabled:
  506                  raise _model_profile_unavailable()
  507              providers[profile.id] = credential.provider
  508          if agent.runtime_config.get("context_policy") is not None:
  509              try:
  510                  catalog = (
  511                      load_local_context_catalog(self.settings.model_context_catalog_path)
  512                      if self.settings.model_context_catalog_path is not None
  513                      else None
  514                  )
  515                  constrained = []
  516                  for profile in chain:
  517                      metadata = profile.capabilities.context_metadata
  518                      if metadata is None:
  519                          constrained.append(profile)
  520                          continue
  521                      # Source records and catalog references are generated by the
  522                      # server, not evidence supplied by an editable profile.
  523                      metadata = replace(metadata, catalog_ref=None, source_records=None)
  524                      entry = (
  525                          catalog.resolve(
  526                              provider=providers[profile.id],
  527                              model=profile.model,
  528                              deployment_id=metadata.deployment_id,
  529                          )
  530                          if catalog is not None
  531                          else None
  532                      )
  533                      metadata, total_context, _source = apply_local_context_catalog(
  534                          provider=providers[profile.id],
  535                          model=profile.model,
  536                          deployment_id=metadata.deployment_id,
  537                          catalog=catalog,
  538                          declared_metadata=metadata,
  539                          declared_max_context_tokens=profile.capabilities.max_context_tokens,
  540                      )
  541                      if total_context is None and (
  542                          entry is None
  543                          or entry.metadata.input_output_semantics
  544                          is not InputOutputSemantics.INDEPENDENT_INPUT_OUTPUT
  545                          or entry.metadata.max_input_tokens is None
  546                      ):
  547                          raise ValueError("input-only capacity needs an exact trusted catalog entry")
  548                      constrained.append(
  549                          replace(
  550                              profile,
  551                              capabilities=replace(
  552                                  profile.capabilities,
  553                                  context_metadata=metadata,
  554                                  max_context_tokens=total_context,
  555                              ),
  556                          )
  557                      )
  558                  chain = tuple(constrained)
  559              except (TypeError, ValueError):
  560                  raise AgentHubError(
  561                      "INVALID_CONTEXT_POLICY",
  562                      "Model capability sources are invalid or insufficient for this policy.",
  563                      422,
  564                  ) from None
